correctness.rationale: For x=ru, membership of each Thales ball is equivalent to r<=u.v_i; the simplex gauge equals d*r*(-min_i u.v_i). Averaging the top m vertices and the min vertex reduces to the maximum product of two linear forms, with sharp rank-two eigenvalue (||s||||t||+s.t)/2. Explicit eigenvectors achieve all bounds; strict inner-product ordering classifies exactly (d+1) binom(d,m) maximizers. Direct independent standard-library geometric diagnostics passed 284683 finite assertions for dimensions 2 through 11; no finite test is used to infer the general theorem.

value.rationale: The invariant is the least centroidal dilation of a simplex containing the union of its m-fold Thales-ball overlaps, a natural quantitative strengthening of diameter-ball coverage. It gives an entire hierarchy, a sharp all-dimensional containment threshold m=d, exact equality multiplicities and dimension-dependent exterior spillover, not an arbitrary isolated parameter computation.
